sentences.text: Le chalet où l'équipe de Manon part en séminaire surplombe un ravin.
sentences.en: The chalet where Manon's team goes on its retreat overlooks a ravine.
sentences.ko: 마농의 팀이 워크숍을 가는 산장은 골짜기를 내려다보고 있어요.

sentences.text: Dans le bois, Julien tombe sur la carcasse rouillée d'une vieille voiture.
sentences.en: In the woods, Julien comes across the rusty shell of an old car.
sentences.ko: 쥘리앵은 숲에서 녹슨 낡은 자동차 뼈대를 우연히 발견해요.

sentences.text: Manon recycle la carcasse d'un vieil ordinateur pour en faire une lampe.
sentences.en: Manon recycles the casing of an old computer to make a lamp.
sentences.ko: 마농은 낡은 컴퓨터 껍데기를 재활용해 조명을 만들어요.

sentences.text: Julien a choisi un coin ensoleillé pour sécher les serviettes.
sentences.en: Julien has chosen a sunny spot to dry the towels.
sentences.ko: 쥘리앵은 수건을 말리려고 볕이 잘 드는 자리를 골랐어요.

sentences.text: Manon profite d'un midi ensoleillé pour coder sur la terrasse.
sentences.en: Manon makes the most of a sunny lunchtime to code on the terrace.
sentences.ko: 마농은 볕 좋은 점심시간에 테라스에서 코딩해요.
